timed_region: Algorithmic preprocessing is included. The timer starts at line 541 before qtClustering, which computes pairwise Euclidean distances to construct neighbor counts and CSR neighbor tables, derives offsets and batching information, then grows candidates using cached maximum distances. All CPU/OpenMP clustering decisions, MPI winner selection, membership broadcasts, and GPU updates occur inside the call. Every rank synchronizes its GPU before returning; the stop timestamp follows the world barrier at line 545. Before timing, only input generation and coordinate distribution occur.
start_synchronization: The initial barrier alone would not establish a root makespan. Here qtClustering first calls MPI_Comm_split_type on MPI_COMM_WORLD. The supplied pinned Open MPI implementation performs a blocking world allreduce of invocation-specific split_type/key inputs before every successful return. Root supplies its contribution only after recording cluster_start. Consequently, no rank can return from this gate and begin algorithmic preprocessing before root starts its timer. Work preceding the gate is runtime setup.
stop_synchronization: Blocking device-to-host copies complete intermediate candidate kernels. cudaDeviceSynchronize at line 412 completes all outstanding GPU work on every rank, including the final markClustered kernel. Every rank then returns from qtClustering and enters the final world barrier. Root records its stop only after that barrier, establishing completion of all useful rank work.
rank_aggregation: There is no elapsed-time reduction, but root's interval is a demonstrated equivalent global makespan: its start precedes every rank's algorithmic work through the pinned communicator-creation gate, and its stop follows every rank's CPU/GPU completion through the final barrier. Simultaneous barrier returns are unnecessary for this proof.
reported_value: Only rank zero prints Clustering time: %ld ms using its own cluster_time.count(). This is the same-rank timestamp difference cast to integer milliseconds. The supplied target ABI establishes that count() is an eight-byte long, matching %ld. No elapsed-time MPI datatype or cross-rank timestamp subtraction is involved. Millisecond truncation can yield zero for sub-millisecond work, but no material workload-specific zero-time issue is established; the configured timeout is far below duration overflow limits.
semantic_equivalence_basis: The reference includes on-demand Euclidean distance evaluation, candidate growth, and cluster selection. The replacement includes neighbor-table preprocessing, incremental distance caching, distributed candidate selection, and membership updates in the reported global interval. Extra runtime setup and allocation inside that interval are conservative.

evidence.finding: The work before timing generates coordinates, broadcasts them, and executes an initial barrier; it computes no clustering distances or neighbor information.
qtClustering begins with the world/shared communicator split, before CUDA setup or algorithmic preprocessing. The supplied pinned implementation facts establish its world-allreduce start gate.
countNeighbors performs the earliest pairwise distance and threshold computations, producing per-seed neighbor counts.
Inside qtClustering, the count kernel and blocking result copy precede CPU CSR-offset computation, input-dependent scratch planning, and fillNeighbors construction of the neighbor table.
Candidate growth selects eligible points and evaluates further Euclidean distances while updating cached maximum distances.
The joined OpenMP reduction computes the local winner, and MPI_Allreduce selects the global winner inside the clustering call. Its unsigned-long-long buffer matches MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG.

Winner reconstruction completes through a blocking device-to-host copy; membership broadcast, joined host updates, and GPU marking remain inside the call. Every rank executes cudaDeviceSynchronize before returning.
The timer encloses qtClustering and the final world barrier. Non-root ranks return after timing, and root prints the resulting integer-millisecond duration under the canonical label.

notes: This verdict applies to the supplied full hybrid benchmark arguments (-n 5000, default threshold 2.0, without -v or -r), four ranks, and recorded target platform. The start-gate proof relies on the independently supplied static evidence for the installed Open MPI 4.1.6 implementation, not on a general assumption that collectives are barriers. The supplied chrono ABI probe supports the reporting type. Final validation, statistics, and result serialization occur after timing and do not advance clustering decisions. No tools or execution were used.
